description.en: Original simplified fossil-specimen study informed by identified N14-03 in Evans et al2026 Fig2I, not a replica, scan, exact measured specimen or living organism. This is a negative-hyporelief impression in an artistic sandstone slab. Fossil length nominal35mm within nominal50x65x6mm slab, chosen illustrative hand scale, not source measurement. Conventional anterior label ambiguous without movement direction; modules may be bilateral but exact symmetry across median is unresolved. No settled arthropod identity, eyes, legs, feeding or behaviour claim.
